definitions.submit: the initiating transaction is signed and sent; Mode A uses the direct admin call, Mode B uses the multisig add_request call
definitions.optimistic_ms: wall time from submit until a view call against the latest optimistic block observes the effect
definitions.final_ms: wall time from submit until the transaction is FINAL and a view call against the final block observes the effect
definitions.effect_block: earliest block whose post-state shows the effect, found by block-height bisection
definitions.blocks_to_effect_optimistic: inclusive block count from the submit block through the effect block
definitions.blocks_to_effect_final: inclusive block count from the submit block through the final block at which the effect was observed
